name: walma
description: Walma AI Hub plugins & skills. Install plugins to register your workspace with your organization's AI Hub and to use platform-integrated tooling.

plugins.name: walma-repo-context
plugins.description: Identifies the git repository each Claude Code session works in, for reliable repo attribution and governance in your AI Hub. Fire-and-forget PreToolUse hook; no admin rights required.

plugins.name: adobe-for-creativity
plugins.description: Adobe Creative Cloud tools for images, vectors, design and video: batch photo edits, resizing for different platforms, quick video cuts, portrait retouching, social variations and document conversion. Vendored from adobe/skills (Apache-2.0) because Claude Desktop on 3P does not fetch cross-repository plugin sources from an admin-configured marketplace.
